# Transistors 101

## Episode 20: BJT Power Amps 2: Chasing Efficiency

[Video link](https://youtu.be/FZghXAPJzxU)

Please join me in supporting [World Central Kitchen](https://donate.wck.org/team/806315)

In this episode, we continue our journey into building BJT power amplifiers,
by trying to maximize efficiency - that is, trying to squeeze the most power
out of our amp while staying within thermal limits.  We look at selecting
ballast resistor values, tuning the power supply voltage, using Sziklai pairs
instead of single transistors for the output stage, and designing the bias
servo for the appropriate quiescent current.
